pcs.pc_description: retrieve agricultural produce from the warehouse/cold storage
check the quality of produce based on physical and sensory parameters
set controls for float/water tank and pump water to the required level for washing produce
use chlorine in the recommended quantity in the water to kill pathogenic and non-pathogenic micro-organisms
wash the produce to remove impurities including chlorine from their surface
dry the washed fruits and vegetables following the appropriate method
clean the produce unsuitable for water treatment
apply waxing treatment depending on the type of produce to reduce water loss and improve appearance
identify and remove the severely damaged produce
separate the unwanted material from the produce following the appropriate method
remove dry foliage attached to the onion and garlic bulbs and sort them based on their size using measurement rings of different diameters
sort the produce based on colour, and record the readings
grade the produce based on diameter, length, weight and size
sample the produce and coordinate their quality analysis with the quality-testing lab, as required
collect the sorted and graded produce using appropriate accessories, such as baskets, tubs, crates, etc
identify and report any malfunctions/ discrepancies to the supervisor and take appropriate corrective action, as instructed
carry the containers with sorted and graded produce to the packaging area safely
carry out primary and secondary packaging of the produce, as applicable

carry out labelling of the produce with the necessary information as per the applicable FSSAI guidelines, e.g. net weight, batch code, date of packing, best before date, storage conditions, country of origin, etc
store the packed produce in a clean and hygienic storage area, under the recommended temperature and humidity
use appropriate storage accessories, such as cartons, crates, gunny bags, and mesh, to store the packed produce
follow the organisational procedure to dispatch the packed produce to their destination using a suitable transportation method
clean and disinfect the work area, tools, equipment and machinery using the recommended cleaning agents
follow the appropriate Clean-in-place (CIP) and Clean-out-of-Place (COP) methods
carry out basic repair and maintenance of the tools, equipment and machinery
ensure periodic maintenance of the tools, equipment and machinery as per the manufacturer’s instructions
carry out appropriate documentation concerning the sorting, grading, packing and storage of fruits and vegetables
